description.p: A terminal emulator for LCOS with the look of an old CRT monitor: phosphor glow, scanlines, burn-in, curvature, RGB shift and an optional monitor bezel, after cool-retro-term 1.2.0 but without Qt. The default profile is a plain terminal without any effects.
The effects run on the GPU (OpenGL 3.3) with a C++ fallback, and drop to a static picture on slow software rendering so an idle terminal uses no CPU.
Development snapshot (M2): effects quality levels, HiDPI, RGB shift, bezel, tabs, search and a settings dialog.
